from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
EXCLUDE_DIRS = {
    ".venv", ".git", "__pycache__", ".ruff_cache", ".pytest_cache",
    ".mypy_cache", "node_modules", ".idea", ".tox", "build", "dist",
}

files: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
    dirnames[:] = sorted(d for d in dirnames if d not in EXCLUDE_DIRS)
    for name in sorted(filenames):
        if name.endswith(".py"):
            p = Path(dirpath) / name
            try:
                text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            except OSError:
                continue
            files.append((p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), len(text.splitlines())))

files.sort(key=lambda t: t[0])

total_lines = sum(n for _, n in files)
width = max((len(f) for f, _ in files), default=0)

lines = []
lines.append("Python files under current directory (excluding .venv, .git, caches)")
lines.append("=" * 60)
lines.extend(f"{n:>6}  {f}" for f, n in files)
lines.append("=" * 60)
lines.append(f"Total Python files: {len(files)}")
lines.append(f"Total lines: {total_lines}")

Path("py_stats.txt").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

print(f"files={len(files)} lines={total_lines}")
